hypotheses.claim: On matched frozen trajectories, simple post-hoc trajectory/residual-pressure/capacity readouts match or beat jointly learned halt gates on verified outcome per cost and false-halt rate.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A trained halt gate materially dominates simple readouts once tuned on representative FRANK trajectories.
hypotheses.falsifier: H1 matched-compute replay shows a learned gate Pareto-dominates simple R8/post-hoc readouts across OOD episodes without trajectory degradation or recovery regressions.

hypotheses.claim: A strong provenance-bound peer verifier improves local 4B correction/decision quality more than local self-verification at acceptable latency/context cost.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Peer verification adds stale-state, confirmation, latency and dependency costs that erase its quality gain.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched H1 episodes show no material verified-outcome gain versus local self-verification or unacceptable peer-loss degradation/cost.

hypotheses.claim: A multimodal Qwen-class 4B can provide numerical vision features for Clay-native Retina/MVC semantics without a second full vision model and without unacceptable target-host cost/failure coupling.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Separate vision backing is more stable, cheaper, more accessible or more robust for open-set personal learning.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target-shaped benchmark shows inaccessible/unstable features, materially worse unknown rejection or calibration, unacceptable latency/RAM, coupled failures, or unsafe feature-version migration.

hypotheses.claim: Opaque runtime capability handles plus release-time revalidation and OS sandboxing reduce ambient-authority failures without materially reducing legitimate tool completion.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The handle/gateway architecture adds complexity without enough security benefit, or stronger process isolation is required.
hypotheses.falsifier: Production Ubuntu adversarial tests show forged/stale/revoked paths remain exploitable, or legitimate completion regresses materially versus a safer simpler alternative.

hypotheses.claim: Bounded task-conditioned ActiveAssembly plus evidence-preserving peer backflow outperforms raw/full-state mirror baselines for a local 4B at matched context and latency.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Raw retrieval or fuller mirrors preserve rare details better enough to dominate compiled Assemblies.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched long-horizon H1/target-shaped tests show lower task success, higher catastrophic omission or worse correction after peer loss at equal resource budget.
